for **every** approval source — not just edits."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"> English | 中文"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"A deliberately minimal plugin with one generic rule: **Enter always presses
the confirm button (the "},{"id":"p5s2","text":"primary, right-most action); Esc always presses the
cancel button** — on every button-bearing intera"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"ction panel the harness
renders."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"| Panel | Enter → confirm | Esc → cancel |"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"| Approval (`[data-approval-key]`) | Allow once | Reject |
| Question / choice (`[data-question-key]"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"`) | Submit / Next | Discard the group |
| Plan review (`[data-plan-review-key]`) | Approve | Declin"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"xt | Discard the group |
| Plan review (`[data-plan-review-key]`) | Approve | Decline (or discuss) |"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"The panel anchors are harness-generic, so the hotkeys work on every
interaction the GUI shows — edit"},{"id":"p8s2","text":" approvals, permission escalations, tool
questions, plan reviews. This is the Claude Code habit: con"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"firm with Enter,
refuse with Esc."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"### Approval panel"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Every approval — edits, permission escalations, anything routed through the
ApprovalPanel. **Enter**"},{"id":"p10s2","text":" presses *Allow once*, **Esc** presses *Reject*."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"### Question / choice panel"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Tool questions (`ask_user_question`). **Enter** presses *Submit / Next*,
**Esc** presses *Discard th"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"tions (`ask_user_question`). **Enter** presses *Submit / Next*,
**Esc** presses *Discard the group*."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"### Plan review panel"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"**Enter** presses *Approve*, **Esc** presses *Decline* (or *Discuss* when
the panel has no decline a"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"** presses *Approve*, **Esc** presses *Decline* (or *Discuss* when
the panel has no decline action)."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Restart `dsh web` — or, since this plugin is pure browser-side, just refresh the page when the host "},{"id":"p17s2","text":"side did not change. No configuration, no settings page."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Supported harness versions: **DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` up to (not including) `0.3.0`**, declared as `dsh.eng"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"ines.dsh` and verified against both ends (`0.2.0-rc.2`, npm `latest`, and `0.2.1-alpha.5`, npm `alph"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"a`). Since DSH 0.2.x that one field decides plugin admission **alone** — the harness ignores peer ra"},{"id":"p18s4","text":"nges when it is present — and a release whose window does not admit the running version is **skipped"},{"id":"p18s5","text":" entirely** at startup, so the window carries a ceiling instead of admitting an unverified future li"},{"id":"p18s6","text":"ne. A release targets one DSH line; older lines are served by the release frozen on them. See docs/r"},{"id":"p18s7","text":"ase targets one DSH line; older lines are served by the release frozen on them. See docs/release.md."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Why this plugin still exists: the harness now ships approval hotkeys of its own, but they are bound "},{"id":"p19s2","text":"to the panel element and fire only once focus is inside it (`currentTarget.contains(document.activeE"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"lement)`) — the user has to click the panel first. This plugin covers the missing case (panel on scr"},{"id":"p19s4","text":"een, focus anywhere else), and the two cannot double-fire: the harness handler calls `preventDefault"},{"id":"p19s5","text":"()` and `stopPropagation()` from inside the React root, while this listener sits on `document`, abov"},{"id":"p19s6","text":"e it, and also ignores an already-prevented key."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"For contributors: install from a local checkout or a pinned commit — `dsh plugin --profile web add /"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"path/to/dsh-approval-hotkeys` or `dsh plugin --profile web add github:SiriLee/dsh-approval-hotkeys#<"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"sha>`. A git install fails on first run until you add an `allowBuilds` key to the profile's `pnpm-wo"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"rkspace.yaml` (pnpm blocks git dependencies from running build scripts); after that it runs the plug"},{"id":"p20s5","text":"in's `prepare` and installs it."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"- **Enter → confirm**: clicks the panel's primary button — the last button
of its action row ("Allow"},{"id":"p22s2","text":" once", "Submit/Next", "Approve"). The harness's
`Button` component has no stable `data-variant` att"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"ribute (variants are
CSS-Modules hash classes), so the plugin anchors on the layout contract
that th"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"e confirm action always renders last — which is exactly the
primary-colored button.
- **Esc → cancel"},{"id":"p22s5","text":"**: clicks the panel's cancel button — Reject (first),
Discard (header), Decline (footer second-last"},{"id":"p22s6","text":", or Discuss when the panel
has no decline action). Without a panel, Esc is left alone (no pause/sto"},{"id":"p22s7","text":"p
binding — the GUI's own stop button and shortcuts own that)."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"### Guards (what the plugin deliberately does NOT do)"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"- **Never while typing**: keydown inside an input / textarea / select /
contentEditable (the compose"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"r owns `Enter`/`Esc` there — e.g.
`Shift+Enter` newline, `Esc` dismisses suggestions).
- **Enter wit"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"h focus on a button**: left to the browser (it activates the
focused button natively) and to the pan"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"el itself (the question composer's
options submit on Enter) — acting again would double-fire.
- **Ne"},{"id":"p24s5","text":"ver on chords or repeats**: `Ctrl/Meta/Alt+key` combinations and
held-key repeats are left alone.
- "},{"id":"p24s6","text":"**Never mid-composition**: an IME-confirming `Enter` (`isComposing`, or the
legacy `keyCode` 229) is"},{"id":"p24s7","text":" a candidate pick, not an answer.
- **Esc with no panel**: left alone — the plugin never stops or pa"},{"id":"p24s8","text":"uses the
agent; panels are the only surface it acts on.
- **Never on a panel the runtime does not vo"},{"id":"p24s9","text":"uch for**: when the runtime reports
what is awaiting an answer here, that request is the only thing "},{"id":"p24s10","text":"the hotkeys
answer — a settled or foreign panel left in the DOM is not clicked through a
positional "},{"id":"p24s11","text":"tkeys
answer — a settled or foreign panel left in the DOM is not clicked through a
positional guess."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"### Button resolution contract (`data-hotkey="none"`)"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"Enter/Esc resolve their buttons **by position** (first / last / header-last /
footer-last), not by a"},{"id":"p26s2","text":" stable semantic attribute — the harness's `Button`
component exposes no reliable `data-role`/`data-"},{"id":"p26s3","text":"variant`, so position is the
only stable signal available to a client plugin that does not own the p"},{"id":"p26s4","text":"anel
DOM. That makes button order the single coupling point to the harness layout."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"To keep that coupling safe when **other plugins** inject buttons into a panel
(utility toggles, deco"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"rative controls), this plugin skips any button marked
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"## Security"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"Pure browser-side plugin: the host half is an empty stub, and all behavior is a document-level keydo"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"wn listener that clicks existing panel buttons. No network requests, no file access, no credentials."}],"truncated":true}
